independence_evidence: Self-published title run by its two founders (about page); sold through KD Presse; no parent company anywhere.
qualifies_reason: Independent Paris photography and art journal whose N°14 (2025) and N°15 (June 2026) are both printed and on sale.
what_it_is: Aleï Journal is a Paris-based print journal of photography, art and essays that gives space to image-makers with raw or unconventional practices, with long photographic portfolios and little text. Each issue is published with several alternative covers by different photographers (N°15 has at least three). It suits readers of contemporary fashion and art photography and collectors of photo publications.

uncertainties: The publisher's site is a minimal portfolio (Lay Theme) with no imprint, address or shop; its Buy page only lists issues up to #11 (November 2023) and links to KD Presse. Paris as city rests on stockist/distributor descriptions ('biannual magazine based in Paris') plus the Paris-centred stockist list, not on a publisher statement.
Cover price: no publisher shop; KD Presse (the publisher's designated sales channel) sells N°15 at EUR 30.
Frequency: described by stockists as biannual, but the actual cadence is N°13 October 2024, N°14 May 2025, N°15 June 2026, i.e. roughly one issue a year recently.
Latest issue date taken from the KD Presse listing date (23 June 2026); the publisher gives no date.
